opening.argument: The video presents PlusToken as a cryptocurrency wallet and arbitrage service, directs viewers to download the wallet, and tells them they can send multiple currencies into the arbitrage trade. The service is described as an income source, with the RE Dog said to generate profits of 6% to 18% credited daily, while entrusted assets are claimed to be unaffected by price fluctuation. That combination of transferring multiple currencies, specific recurring returns, and protection claims is the central basis for the concern. The video also explicitly characterizes the app as an intelligent source of income. Whether the download worked, returns were paid, or any transaction occurred is not established.

citations.quote: Connecting to PlusToken is easy, download Wallet, wallet for IOS, (I-Phone):
You can send multiple currencies into the arbitrage trade.
The RE Dog will generate profits for you, which range between 6% and 18%, and are credited to your account daily.
The assets entrusted to us are completely unaffected by price fluctuation.
So you can see the Plustoken app as an intelligent source of income.
